container.measure: Gross District Domestic Product (GDDP) at current prices
container.area: Hyderabad district, Telangana (217 km²) — NOTE: a SUBSET of the city, not a superset

container.notes: GHMC (~650 km², 6.81m in 2011) spans four districts; Hyderabad district lies wholly inside GHMC and holds ~58% of GHMC's population (3.94m / 6.81m, 2011 Census) — it is the unit holding most of the city, per the rules, but it is SMALLER than the city, so a city-limits figure would be higher. The rest of GHMC is in Rangareddy (GDDP 2022-23 ₹2,83,419 cr) and Medchal-Malkajgiri (₹88,867 cr), both of which also contain large non-GHMC areas, so they cannot be added. Newer GDDP (2023-24 in SEO 2025, 2024-25 in SEO 2026) probably exists but could not be reached (state portal blocked, search budget exhausted) — worth updating. Only containing unit that holds ALL of GHMC is Telangana state.

reason: Telangana publishes district GDDP only; no GHMC-level GDP. Hyderabad district is not "near" coterminous (it is only ~58% of GHMC's population).

Pakistan publishes no official GDP below national level: PBS compiles national accounts only; no official Sindh provincial GDP or Karachi division/city figure exists (only academic/World Bank estimates).

No official sub-national GDP could be verified: BBS publishes national GDP; a BBS district-GDP release (Dhaka District) could not be confirmed (bbs.gov.bd unreachable, web-search budget exhausted). Wikipedia shows "$50.1 bn (2023)" for Dhaka District with no source — not used. Dhaka District (14.7m, 2022 Census) is also larger than the two city corporations. Worth a manual check for a BBS "District GDP" publication.

Cambodia's National Institute of Statistics publishes GDP only for the whole country (no capital/provincial GDP); Phnom Penh Capital is a first-level unit, so no smaller-than-country container exists.
North Korea publishes no official GDP at any level; Bank of Korea estimates cover the national economy only.
